name: Custom Discounts for Point of Sale
description: Easily apply and manage custom discounts directly in your Odoo POS. This module empowers cashiers and managers to offer flexible price reductions, track discount reasons, and enhance customer satisfaction
summary: The POS Custom Discount app for Odoo is a powerful and user-friendly extension designed to give businesses more flexibility and control over discount management within their Point of Sale operations. Standard POS modules typically provide fixed promotional discounts, but they often lack the ability to create customized offers that meet specific business needs. This app bridges that gap by introducing a Custom Discount feature, allowing POS users to create, apply, and track both predefined and custom discounts directly from the POS interface. With this app, administrators can enable the Custom Discount option from the Odoo backend under the POS settings. Once activated, the POS interface will display a dedicated “Custom Discount” button, alongside any existing discount schemes like seasonal promotions (e.g., “Christmas Offer”) or store milestones (e.g., “Shop 6-Year Completion”). This empowers cashiers or sales staff to either apply predefined discounts to selected order lines or the entire order, or create new custom discounts instantly during checkout. The process is straightforward: after selecting products in the POS cart, the cashier can open the discount dialog to choose from available offers or click on the Custom Discount button to create a new one. The system prompts the user to enter a discount percentage and a reason, ensuring that every custom discount is not only applied correctly but also documented for transparency. Discounts can be applied to individual items (Selected Line) or the entire order (All Line). This ensures maximum flexibility, whether the business wants to promote specific products or reward loyal customers with special order-wide deals. name: POS Lot & Serial Selection
description: This module extends Odoo Point of Sale (POS) by allowing cashiers to select Lot/Serial Numbers directly during the POS sales process. It also supports Expiration Date tracking for better inventory management
summary: The POS Lot/Serial Selection Module provides a seamless solution for managing serialized products within Odoo’s Point of Sale system. This module ensures that every item sold through POS can be tracked with precise lot or serial numbers, enabling businesses to maintain accurate inventory control, streamline operations, and enhance product traceability. In the backend, users can easily create and manage lot/serial numbers for products. For example, a product like Storage Box can have multiple serial numbers assigned (e.g., Ser/01, Ser/02, Ser/03, Ser/04). Each serial number is tied to its own available quantity, expiration date, and history, ensuring businesses can track stock at the most detailed level. The system also provides options for replenishment and history review, helping managers stay informed about stock levels and product movements. In the POS interface, when a cashier selects a serialized product, a popup appears prompting them to choose from available lot/serial numbers. The interface displays key details such as available quantity, expiration date, removal date, and use date for each serial number, allowing accurate selection during sales. This step eliminates errors and ensures the right serials are allocated to customers. Users can adjust the required quantity by increasing or decreasing the number of units selected for each serial, making the process flexible and straightforward.
